scope: Offline first-provisioning and production resume boundary for three private conversion journals

baselineObservation.result: One saved unknown signed attempt, then a same-context missing-file journal initialized empty; no new signature or broadcast. Local synthetic fixture only.

implementation: Normal prepareTokenConversionRuntime always verifies all three published role-labelled journals before service authentication or custody access.

A separate explicit first-provisioning helper binds the exact release, signer policy and three distinct journal references to a reviewed digest and evidence hash, checks all three files are absent, and writes each role label under the locked durable store.
Missing, corrupt, wrong-context or wrong-role journals cannot resume; a partial first-provisioning failure cannot be silently retried as a normal runtime startup.
The public HTTP request body has no first-provisioning path. Existing signed attempts and finalized proof are reconciled from intact journals without a new send.
limits: The digest and evidence hash identify reviewed inputs; they are not cryptographic proof that an independent review occurred.
No actual production journal has been provisioned, restored or admitted.
Three-store publication is not an atomic multi-file transaction; a partial failure requires manual review and complete restore before retry.
Independent exact-source QA, operational backup/restore, independent signer custody, live finality and Mainnet release acceptance remain open.
No wallet key, signing, broadcast, deployment, funding or activation was used.
